title: Tunisian Tagine Chicken with Hazelnut Crust
description: A traditional Tunisian dish made with chicken, spices and served in a tagine, topped with a crunchy hazelnut crust. This recipe serves 4 people and is perfect for a weekend dinner.
instructions: Rinse the chicken thighs and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, mix together the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the onion to the tagine and cook until it's browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic to the tagine and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken thighs to the tagine and cook until they're browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and cook for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the hazelnut crust. Chop the hazelnuts in a food processor until they're finely chopped.
Mix the chopped hazelnuts with a little bit of olive oil to form a paste.
Remove the tagine from the oven and brush the hazelnut paste onto the top of the chicken thighs.
Return the tagine to the oven and cook for another 5-10 minutes, or until the hazelnut crust is golden brown.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
